column3: “Returned and built” is rendered “rebuilt,” and “Asherah pole” as “an Asherah.”
“Soothsaying … divination” is rendered “witchcraft … divination,” and “necromancer and soothsayers” as “mediums and spiritists.”
“Spoil and plunder” is rendered “plunder and spoil.”
“Mouth to mouth” is rendered “from one end to another.”
“Someone buried him” is rendered passively, “he was buried.”
